sets.relationshipLabel: an instrument and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: Every instrument has parts that are just built into it — a fretboard on a guitar, a bridge on a violin — no cause or event required, just structure.

sets.relationshipLabel: a piece of music or release and its made visual representation
sets.explanation: A song gets a music video and an album gets cover art — each is the visual object created to represent the audio release.

sets.relationshipLabel: the substance or part that lets the instrument produce sound at all
sets.explanation: Without a reed a clarinet stays silent, and without rosin a bow can't grip the strings — both are the small enabling agent behind the sound.

sets.relationshipLabel: same kind of thing, small scale then large scale
sets.explanation: A tune scaled up becomes a symphony, and applause scaled up becomes an ovation — the same phenomenon, just magnified.
